fullContentHtml:
CISF Constable Tradesmen Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) has released the Exam Date for the post of Constable Tradesmen. This recruitment has released for 1161 posts. Applications for the CISF Constable Tradesmen Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 05 March 2025, to 03 April 2025. The examination is going to conduct on 01 December 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their CISF Constable Tradesmen Exam Date 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Short Notice Date : 17 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 05 March 2025
  • Last Date : 03 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 April 2025
  • PET / PST Exam Start: 26 September 2025
  • PET / PST Admit Card : 17 September 2025
  • PET / PST Result : 02 December 2025
  • Trade Test & DV Start : From 11 December 2025
  • Trade Test & DV Admit Card : 02 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 01 December 2026
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Exam Date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can Check the Exam Date from the official website of CISF also.

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

CISF Constable Tradesmen Exam Date 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
